scope: Seven exact Spot POIs; existing Commons metadata and geographic candidates, visual review, indexed Commons searches and official websites.
meaning: No exact, openly licensed photo was verified in the checked sources. This does not assert that no such photo exists anywhere.
apiLimit: Stopped Commons API search after HTTP 429 on the second request; the first exact search for Asia Park Astana returned zero files. Requests were spaced by five seconds. No retry loop or bulk metadata refetch was used.

places.name: Азия Парк
places.reason: The first photo is explicitly a mosque. The other visually checked nearby images show the Round Square restaurant facade, fountain and skyline, not Asia Park mall. The Commons Asia Park category found by web search is a park in South Korea.
places.officialSourceFinding: The official site confirms Kabanbay Batyr 21. Its legal-information link is a personal-data/privacy policy, not a photo reuse license. No explicit open image license was verified.

places.name: Сарыарка
places.reason: The closest candidate is a night photo of the Triumph of Astana residential towers, not the mall. Other geographic candidates describe an opera building or temporary yurts, not Saryarka mall.
places.officialSourceFinding: The mall's official website confirms Turan 24 and provides photos, but an explicit open reuse license was not verified. Visit Astana has an all-rights-reserved footer.

places.name: Корме
places.reason: Existing exact metadata describes cars outside La Creme and a Chery Arrizo 8, not the Korme exhibition centre. Indexed Commons searches did not identify an exact file.
places.officialSourceFinding: The event organizer confirms the historical venue at Dostyk 3. No exact openly licensed venue photo was verified.

places.name: Парк Арай
places.reason: The closest candidate is a broad city panorama shot from Baiterek, and the next candidate is the Parliament building. Neither is an exact photo of this park entry.
places.officialSourceFinding: Visit Astana states that Aray was reconstructed and renamed Zhetysu in 2018. The snapshot separately includes nearby way/69232075 as Zhetysu; do not duplicate those photos onto this adjacent old-name entry until the OSM polygon relationship is checked.

places.name: Корейский сад
places.reason: Visually checked candidates show a cycle path and the river embankment; they do not depict the identifiable Korean garden pavilion or gate.
places.officialSourceFinding: Official tourism page identifies the garden inside Zhetysu and includes images, but it carries an all-rights-reserved footer rather than an open image license. Generic Zhetysu photographs are not used as exact Korean-garden photos.

places.name: Zur Sultan
places.reason: Nearby photos show Lovers Park, the square and the KazMunayGas arch. Astana-2021-10 - 3.jpg also clearly depicts a bronze couple, which official tourism identifies as the Bakytym Menin/My Happiness sculpture. No source connects the name Zur Sultan to that sculpture, so an identity mismatch remains. A distance of 14-16 metres to the camera alone is not sufficient evidence.

places.name: Табун Лошадей
places.reason: The four checked nearby photographs show the fountain, Transport Tower, Round Square and a restaurant facade; the exact horse group is not the depicted subject. A matching horse-group stock photo was found with a paid editorial license, so it was not added as an open asset.
